name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh, that's creepy. Come on, wake up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai and Misa said they had morning errands, so they headed back early」

name: Synn
message: 「There sure aren't many people around today」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's lively over by the church, though. Wanna go check it out!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel. Out for a morning walk?」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that where everyone goes to pray?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Looking things up on your own every once in a while can be fun too, you know」
Whenever I can't answer something, I'll just use that line from now on.
Beautiful singing voices echo from the chapel, accompanied by a pipe organ.
They really do this kind of thing every single week, huh.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now then, since Lolo-chan's curiosity has been satisfied, shall we head back?」
Ria-senpai did say that taking a break is part of the job, after all.
Now then, what should I do today.
